changelog:
- Expanded and clarified user guidance for managing OKX Earn products via the okx CLI, including Simple Earn, Flash Earn, On-chain Earn, Dual Investment, AutoEarn, and Flash Earn.
- Updated authentication handling: clarified API Key vs OAuth mode detection, emphasized always using live mode, and provided explicit profile validation steps.
- Improved routing instructions: outlined which OKX skill to use for different user intents (earn, trading, bot, portfolio, market).
- Detailed full command index with descriptions, usage contexts, and specific routing notes for each Earn category.
- Specified error handling flow for authentication issues, including automatic routing to re-authentication if needed.
- Added notes on enable/disable restrictions and preview steps for AutoEarn and Fixed Earn functionalities.
summary: Manages OKX Simple Earn (flexible savings/lending), Flash Earn, On-chain Earn (staking/DeFi), Dual Investment (DCD/双币赢), and AutoEarn (自动赚币) via the okx CLI. Use this skill whenever the user wants to check earn balances, browse flash-earn projects, subscribe or redeem earn products, view or set lend
